description: This file defines the Font class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling font styling properties such as name, size, color, underline, and other font attributes. It provides methods for applying styles, managing font properties, and generating style arrays used in spreadsheet formatting.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: Represents font styling options in PhpSpreadsheet, allowing customization of font attributes such as name, size, color, underline, bold, italic, and more. Supports applying styles from arrays and generating style arrays for spreadsheet cells.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style properties to the Font object from an associative array, optionally updating the active sheet if it's a supervisor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the font name, either from the shared component if supervisor or local property.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the font name and resets the scheme property.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the font size, either from shared component if supervisor or local property.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the font size, ensuring positive float value.

methods.name: getBold
methods.description: Returns whether the font is bold, either from shared component if supervisor or local property.

methods.name: setBold
methods.description: Sets the bold property of the font.

methods.name: getItalic
methods.description: Returns whether the font is italic, either from shared component if supervisor or local property.

methods.name: setItalic
methods.description: Sets the italic property.

methods.name: getSuperscript
methods.description: Returns whether the font is superscript, either from shared component if supervisor or local property.

methods.name: setSuperscript
methods.description: Sets the superscript property, ensuring subscript is false if superscript is true.

methods.name: getSubscript
methods.description: Returns whether the font is subscript, either from shared component if supervisor or local property.

methods.name: setSubscript
methods.description: Sets the subscript property, ensuring superscript is false if subscript is true.

methods.name: getUnderline
methods.description: Returns the underline style.

methods.name: setUnderline
methods.description: Sets the underline style, light or boolean interpreted accordingly.

methods.name: getStrikethrough
methods.description: Returns whether strikethrough is active.

methods.name: setStrikethrough
methods.description: Sets the strikethrough property.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the Color object for the font.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the Color object for the font, accepting a Color instance.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the font style for comparison purposes.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the font, shared or local.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the font scheme if the input is valid.
